title: PH rice supply seen rising as groups secure US imports

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines’ rice supplies may increase after two industry groups signed an agreement to source rice from the United States starting next year, marking a step toward reopening and expanding trade in US rice to the archipelago. The memorandum of agreement signed by the USA Rice Federation (USA Rice) and the Philippine Rice Industry Stakeholders Movement (Prism) involves the supply and purchase of US-origin rice.
